bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as a sub-component of a broader 'emergent misalignment' metric. The paper uses a rubric-based, thresholded GPT-4o grader on open-ended prompts to detect if the model outputs explicitly racist statements (classified as 'evil' or misaligned).
